text: raschke: "the break has thrust behind it." Thrust is momentum; C16 asks whether institutions bought the break, and day_vol 1.32 is under the 1.40 bar. Under +40% is a hard rejection, not a weaker buy. Leadership and the BOS at the high are right; the volume is not. What clears me: day_vol 1.40 or more on a push through bar_high while within 5% of the pivot, and then I support on leadership. Market gate delegated; EPS and sponsors unseen by me.
